description_scope: IFC entity semantics only; no claim of actual field availability

View_ActionRequest.description: A request is the act or instance of asking for something, such as a request for information, bid submission, or performance of work.

View_Actor.description: The IfcActor defines all actors or human agents involved in a project during its full life cycle.

View_Actuator.description: An actuator is a mechanical device for moving or controlling a mechanism or system.

View_AirTerminal.description: An air terminal is a terminating or origination point for the transfer of air between distribution system(s) and one or more spaces.

View_AirTerminalBox.description: An HVAC device that regulates the amount of air supplied to downstream ductwork.

View_AirToAirHeatRecovery.description: An air-to-air heat recovery device employs a counter-flow heat exchanger between inbound and outbound air flow.

View_Alarm.description: A device that signals an abnormal condition or activates an alarm signal.

View_Alignment.description: Defines a reference system for linear positioning and the geometric layout of linear infrastructure, including horizontal, vertical, and cant layouts.

View_AlignmentCant.description: An IfcAlignmentCant is a lateral inclination profile defined along the horizontal alignment.

View_AlignmentHorizontal.description: An IfcAlignmentHorizontal is a linear reference projected onto the horizontal x/y plane.

View_AlignmentSegment.description: A portion of an alignment with a defined mathematical description of its horizontal direction, vertical direction, or railway cant.

View_AlignmentVertical.description: An IfcAlignmentVertical is a height profile along the horizontal alignment.

View_Annotation.description: An information element that adds notes or meaning to objects within the project's geometric and spatial context.

View_Asset.description: An identifiable group of elements treated as one asset with financial value.

View_AudioVisualAppliance.description: An audio-visual appliance is a device that displays, captures, transmits, or receives audio or video.

View_Beam.description: An individual beam, usually horizontal or nearly horizontal. It is not necessarily load bearing.

View_Bearing.description: A support component that transfers loads between structural parts while usually allowing specified displacement or rotation.

View_Boiler.description: A pressure-rated vessel that heats water or another fluid using an energy source.

View_Borehole.description: A linear geological or geotechnical model that may assemble strata, capping, lining, and related elements.

View_Bridge.description: A civil structure providing passage above obstacles or between elevated points for people, animals, vehicles, or services.

View_Building.description: A structure intended to shelter occupants or contents and normally remain permanently in one place.

View_BuildingElementPart.description: IfcBuildingElementPart represents major components as subordinate parts of a building element.

View_BuildingElementProxy.description: An element represented without a more specific predefined semantic class for the element it represents.

View_BuildingStorey.description: The building storey has an elevation and typically represents a (nearly) horizontal aggregation of spaces that are vertically bound.

View_BuildingSystem.description: A building system is a group by which building elements are grouped according to a common function within the facility.

View_BuiltElement.description: The built element comprises all elements that are primarily part of the construction of a built facility, i.e., its structural and space separating system.

View_BuiltSystem.description: A built system is a group by which built elements are grouped according to a common function within the facility.

View_Burner.description: A burner is a device that converts fuel into heat through combustion.

View_CableCarrierFitting.description: A cable carrier fitting is a fitting that is placed at junction or transition in a cable carrier system.

View_CableCarrierSegment.description: A cable carrier segment is a flow segment that is specifically used to carry and support cabling.

View_CableFitting.description: A cable fitting is a fitting that is placed at a junction, transition or termination in a cable system.

View_CableSegment.description: A cable segment is a flow segment used to carry electrical power, data, or telecommunications signals.

View_CaissonFoundation.description: A foundation formed as an open or closed hollow box.

View_Chiller.description: A refrigeration device that removes heat from a liquid using a vapor-compression or absorption cycle.

View_Chimney.description: Chimneys are typically vertical, or as near as vertical, parts of the construction of a building and part of the building fabric.

View_CivilElement.description: An IfcCivilElement is a generalization of all elements within a civil engineering works that cannot be represented as BuildingElements, DistributionElements or GeographicElements.

View_Coil.description: A coil is a device used to provide heat transfer between non-mixing media.

View_Column.description: A vertical structural or architectural member, often located at an intersection of the structural grid.

View_CommunicationsAppliance.description: A communications appliance transmits and receives electronic or digital information as data or sound.

View_Compressor.description: A compressor is a device that compresses a fluid typically used in a refrigeration circuit.

View_Condenser.description: A heat-rejection device that typically condenses a substance from gas to liquid.

View_ConstructionEquipmentResource.description: IfcConstructionEquipmentResource is usage of construction equipment to assist in the performance of construction.

View_ConstructionMaterialResource.description: IfcConstructionMaterialResource identifies a material resource type in a construction project.

View_ConstructionProductResource.description: IfcConstructionProductResource defines the role of a product that is consumed (wholly or partially), or occupied in the performance of construction.

View_Controller.description: A controller is a device that monitors inputs and controls outputs within a building automation system.

View_ConveyorSegment.description: A continuous conveyor run connecting sections of a conveyor system, using a carrying mechanism such as a belt, chain, or screw.

View_CooledBeam.description: A chilled-beam device that cools room air by circulating fluid through exposed finned tubes above a space.

View_CoolingTower.description: A device that rejects heat to ambient air by circulating and partially evaporating a fluid.

View_CostItem.description: A cost or financial value with contextual information, used as an item within a cost schedule.

View_CostSchedule.description: A collection of cost items for an estimate, bill of quantities, work order, or another cost-related presentation.

View_Course.description: A long, relatively thin layer of material laid on site over another horizontal or nearly horizontal built element.

View_Covering.description: A finishing or protective covering applied to a surface or element, such as flooring, ceiling, cladding, insulation, or roofing.

View_CrewResource.description: IfcCrewResource represents a collection of internal resources used in construction processes.

View_CurtainWall.description: A wall assembly hung from the floor or roof structure rather than supported directly on a floor.

View_Damper.description: A damper typically participates in an HVAC duct distribution system and is used to control or modulate the flow of air.

View_DeepFoundation.description: Deep foundation is a type of foundation that transfers loads deeper than shallow foundation below the soft soils not capable of bearing the above structure.

View_DiscreteAccessory.description: A discrete accessory is a representation of different kinds of accessories included in or added to elements.

View_DistributionBoard.description: A flow controller that groups electrical or communications devices at one location for a particular purpose.

View_DistributionChamberElement.description: A distribution chamber element defines a place at which distribution systems and their constituent elements may be inspected or through which they may travel.

View_DistributionCircuit.description: A distribution circuit is a partition of a distribution system that is conditionally switched such as an electrical circuit.

View_DistributionControlElement.description: The distribution element IfcDistributionControlElement defines occurrence elements of a building automation control system that are used to impart control over elements of a distribution system.

View_DistributionElement.description: IfcDistributionElement is a generalization of all elements that participate in a distribution system.

View_DistributionFlowElement.description: The distribution element IfcDistributionFlowElement defines occurrence elements of a distribution system that facilitate the distribution of energy or matter, such as air, water or power.

View_DistributionPort.description: A distribution port is an inlet or outlet of a product through which a particular substance may flow.

View_DistributionSystem.description: A distribution system is a network designed to receive, store, maintain, distribute, or control the flow of a distribution media.

View_Door.description: The door is a built element that is predominately used to provide controlled access for people, goods, animals and vehicles.

View_DuctFitting.description: A junction or transition connecting duct segments and changing flow characteristics such as direction or flow rate.

View_DuctSegment.description: A duct segment is used to typically join two sections of duct network.

View_DuctSilencer.description: A device installed in ductwork to reduce noise from airflow or equipment in adjacent spaces or downstream ducts.

View_EarthworksCut.description: The resulting void from modification of existing terrain or road structure by excavation or by other means of removing material.

View_EarthworksElement.description: An element created by earthworks to form subgrade, raise ground levels, or reinforce or stabilize soil.

View_EarthworksFill.description: A type of earthworks element created by earthwork activities to build subgrade or to raise the level of the ground in general.

View_ElectricAppliance.description: An electric appliance is a device intended for consumer usage that is powered by electricity.

View_ElectricDistributionBoard.description: A distribution board is a flow controller in which instances of electrical devices are brought together at a single place for a particular purpose.

View_ElectricFlowStorageDevice.description: An electric flow storage device is a device in which electrical energy is stored and from which energy may be progressively released.

View_ElectricFlowTreatmentDevice.description: An electric flow treatment device is used to remove unwanted matter from an electric or electronic signal in a flow distribution system.

View_ElectricGenerator.description: An electric generator is an engine that is a machine for converting mechanical energy into electrical energy.

View_ElectricMotor.description: An electric motor is an engine that is a machine for converting electrical energy into mechanical energy.

View_ElectricTimeControl.description: An electric time control is a device that applies control to the provision or flow of electrical energy over time.

View_ElementAssembly.description: The IfcElementAssembly represents complex element assemblies aggregated from several elements, such as discrete elements, building elements, or other elements.

View_EnergyConversionDevice.description: A device within a distribution system that converts energy or transfers heat.

View_Engine.description: An engine is a device that converts fuel into mechanical energy through combustion.

View_EvaporativeCooler.description: An evaporative cooler is a device that cools air by saturating it with water vapor.

View_Evaporator.description: An evaporator is a device in which a liquid refrigerent is vaporized and absorbs heat from the surrounding fluid.

View_Event.description: An IfcEvent is something that happens that triggers an action or response.

View_ExternalSpatialElement.description: The external spatial element defines external regions at the building site.

View_Facility.description: A built facility, such as a building, bridge, railway, road, or marine facility.

View_FacilityPartCommon.description: A part that is not clearly part of one domain but is a hybrid and has shared responsibilities in multiple domains.

View_Fan.description: A fan is a device which imparts mechanical work on a gas.

View_Fastener.description: Representations of fixing parts which are used as fasteners to connect or join elements with other elements.

View_Filter.description: A filter is an apparatus used to remove particulate or gaseous matter from fluids and gases.

View_FireSuppressionTerminal.description: A fire suppression terminal has the purpose of delivering a fluid (gas or liquid) that will suppress a fire.

View_FlowController.description: An element that regulates flow through a distribution system, such as a damper, valve, switch, or relay.

View_FlowFitting.description: The distribution flow element IfcFlowFitting defines the occurrence of a junction or transition in a flow distribution system, such as an elbow or tee.

View_FlowInstrument.description: An instrument displaying a system property at a point or the difference in that property between two points.

View_FlowMeter.description: A flow meter is a device that is used to measure the flow rate in a system.

View_FlowMovingDevice.description: A device that moves or circulates a liquid or gas through a distribution system, such as a pump or fan.

View_FlowSegment.description: The distribution flow element IfcFlowSegment defines the occurrence of a segment of a flow distribution system.

View_FlowStorageDevice.description: A device used for temporary storage within a distribution system, such as a tank.

View_FlowTerminal.description: A permanently attached endpoint or starting point of a distribution system, such as an air outlet, drain, or sink.

View_FlowTreatmentDevice.description: A distribution-system device that removes unwanted material from a liquid or gas.

View_Footing.description: A footing is a part of the foundation of a structure that spreads and transmits the load to the soil.

View_FurnishingElement.description: A furnishing element is a generalization of all furniture related objects.

View_Furniture.description: Furniture defines complete furnishings such as a table, desk, chair, or cabinet, which may or may not be permanently attached to a building structure.

View_GeographicElement.description: An IfcGeographicElement is a generalization of all elements within a geographical landscape.

View_Geomodel.description: Representation of the concept of a volumetric geological and geotechnical model, usually an interpretation but sometimes created direct from ground penetrating measurement.

View_Geoslice.description: Representation of the concept of a sectional planar geological and geotechnical model, usually an interpretation but sometimes created direct from ground penetrating measurement.

View_GeotechnicalStratum.description: A discrete, approximately homogeneous geological feature represented as a solid, a top surface, or voxels.

View_Grid.description: A planar design grid positioned in three-dimensional space to locate structural and other design elements.

View_Group.description: An arbitrary grouping of objects for a shared purpose or organizational context.

View_HeatExchanger.description: A heat exchanger is a device used to provide heat transfer between non-mixing media such as plate and shell and tube heat exchangers.

View_Humidifier.description: A humidifier is a device that adds moisture into the air.

View_ImpactProtectionDevice.description: An impact protection device is a component used to protect other built elements from kinetic damage.

View_Interceptor.description: A gravity drainage device that retains unwanted or hazardous matter while allowing sewage or other liquids to discharge.

View_Inventory.description: An inventory is a list of items within an enterprise.

View_JunctionBox.description: A junction box is an enclosure within which cables are connected.

View_Kerb.description: A border of stone, concrete or other rigid material formed at the edge of the carriageway or footway.

View_LaborResource.description: An IfcLaborResource is used in construction with particular skills or crafts required to perform certain types of construction or management related work.

View_Lamp.description: A lamp is an artificial light source such as a light bulb or tube.

View_LightFixture.description: A housing for one or more lamps, optionally including devices that control or modify their light output.

View_LinearElement.description: A generalization of all linear elements that are parts of an alignment.

View_LinearPositioningElement.description: An IfcLinearPositioningElement is an entity describing positioning according to a curve.

View_LiquidTerminal.description: An endpoint or starting point where a liquid distribution system exchanges liquid with its external environment.

View_MarineFacility.description: A major facility in the ports and waterways domain, such as a quay, jetty, shipyard, or breakwater.

View_MechanicalFastener.description: A component that mechanically joins building elements or their parts.

View_MedicalDevice.description: A medical device is attached to a medical piping system and operates upon medical gases to perform a specific function.

View_Member.description: An IfcMember is a structural member designed to carry loads between or beyond points of support.

View_MobileTelecommunicationsAppliance.description: A mobile telecommunications appliance is a device that transmits, converts, amplifies or receives signals used in mobile networks.

View_MooringDevice.description: An active or passive component used to secure a vessel, such as a bollard or quick-release hook.

View_MotorConnection.description: A motor connection provides the means for connecting a motor as the driving device to the driven device.

View_NavigationElement.description: An active or passive component providing navigational instructions or warnings to vessels, such as a buoy or beacon.

View_Occupant.description: An actor identifying the form of occupancy of a property.

View_OpeningElement.description: The opening element stands for opening, recess or chase, all reflecting voids.

View_Outlet.description: An outlet is a device installed at a point to receive one or more inserted plugs for electrical power or communications.

View_Pavement.description: A road or paved-area element providing an even load-carrying surface for vehicles or pedestrians, usually composed of several courses.

View_PerformanceHistory.description: IfcPerformanceHistory is used to document the actual performance of an occurrence instance over time.

View_Permit.description: A permit is a permission to perform work in places and on artifacts where regulatory, security or other access restrictions apply.

View_Pile.description: A slender foundation member embedded into the ground to support a load.

View_PipeFitting.description: A junction or transition connecting pipe segments and changing flow characteristics such as direction or flow rate.

View_PipeSegment.description: A pipe segment is used to typically join two sections of a piping network.

View_Plate.description: An IfcPlate is a planar and often flat part with constant thickness.

View_Procedure.description: An IfcProcedure is a logical set of actions to be taken in response to an event or to cause an event to occur.

View_Project.description: IfcProject establishes the context for information to be exchanged or shared, and it may represent a construction project but does not have to.

View_ProjectLibrary.description: An IfcProjectLibrary collects all library elements that are included within a referenced project data set.

View_ProjectOrder.description: A project order is a directive to purchase products and/or perform work, such as for construction or facilities management.

View_ProjectionElement.description: The projection element is a specialization of the general feature element to represent projections applied to building elements.

View_ProtectiveDevice.description: A protective device breaks an electrical circuit when a stated electric current that passes through it is exceeded.

View_ProtectiveDeviceTrippingUnit.description: A device that triggers a separate circuit-breaking unit when current exceeds a specified level.

View_Pump.description: A pump is a device which imparts mechanical work on fluids or slurries to move them through a channel or pipeline.

View_Rail.description: A rail is a predominately linear built element that has a special section profile.

View_Railing.description: A frame assembly beside pedestrian or vehicle circulation spaces or boundaries, used in place of or together with walls.

View_Railway.description: An IfcRailway is a spatial structure element as a route from one location to another for guided passage of wheeled vehicles on rails.

View_Ramp.description: An inclined passage linking levels at different elevations.

View_RampFlight.description: A single inclined ramp segment connecting landings, floors, or slabs at different elevations.

View_Referent.description: IfcReferent defines a position at a particular offset along an alignment curve.

View_ReinforcedSoil.description: Soil reinforced or stabilized by some mechanical or chemical method.

View_ReinforcingBar.description: A reinforcing bar is usually made of steel with manufactured deformations in the surface, and used in concrete and masonry construction to provide additional strength.

View_ReinforcingMesh.description: A welded grid of longitudinal and transverse wires or bars, commonly used to reinforce concrete slabs.

View_Road.description: A route built on land to allow travel from one location to another, including highways, streets, cycle and foot paths, but excluding railways.

View_Roof.description: The top covering of a building, protecting it from weather.

View_SanitaryTerminal.description: A fixed water-related appliance or terminal for drinking, cleaning, or foul-water disposal, including equipment directly serving it.

View_Sensor.description: A device that measures a physical quantity and converts the measurement into a readable signal.

View_ShadingDevice.description: A purpose-built device that limits sunlight, natural light, or visibility.

View_Sign.description: A sign is a notice on display that gives information or instructions in a written, symbolic or other form.

View_Signal.description: A signal is an active device that conveys information or instructions to users, by means of an audio, visual signal or a combination of both.

View_Site.description: A site is a defined area of land, possibly covered with water, on which the project construction is to be completed.

View_Slab.description: A slab is a component of the construction that may enclose a space vertically.

View_SolarDevice.description: A solar device converts solar radiation into other energy such as electric current or thermal energy.

View_Space.description: A space represents an area or volume bounded actually or theoretically.

View_SpaceHeater.description: A device that heats a limited space through radiation or natural convection using electricity, steam, or hot water.

View_SpatialZone.description: A spatial zone is a non-hierarchical and potentially overlapping decomposition of the project under some functional consideration.

View_StackTerminal.description: A terminal at the top of a ventilating stack or rainwater pipe, providing protection or collecting discharge from guttering.

View_Stair.description: A stair is a vertical passageway allowing occupants to walk (step) from one floor level to another floor level at a different elevation.

View_StairFlight.description: A stair flight is an assembly of building components in a single "run" of stair steps (not interrupted by a landing).

View_StructuralAnalysisModel.description: The IfcStructuralAnalysisModel is used to assemble all information needed to represent a structural analysis model.

View_StructuralCurveAction.description: A structural curve action defines an action which is distributed over a curve.

View_StructuralCurveConnection.description: A linear structural-analysis connection or support where surface members meet along an edge.

View_StructuralCurveMember.description: A linear structural-analysis idealization of a member such as a beam, column, or rod.

View_StructuralCurveReaction.description: This entity defines a reaction which occurs distributed over a curve.

View_StructuralLinearAction.description: This entity defines an action with constant value which is distributed over a curve.

View_StructuralLoadCase.description: A load case is a load group, commonly used to group loads from the same action source.

View_StructuralLoadGroup.description: The entity IfcStructuralLoadGroup is used to structure the physical impacts.

View_StructuralPlanarAction.description: This entity defines an action with constant value which is distributed over a surface.

View_StructuralPointAction.description: This entity defines an action which acts on a point.

View_StructuralPointConnection.description: Instances of IfcStructuralPointConnection describe structural nodes or point supports.

View_StructuralPointReaction.description: This entity defines a reaction which occurs at a point.

View_StructuralResultGroup.description: Instances of the entity IfcStructuralResultGroup are used to group results of structural analysis calculations and to capture the connection to the underlying basic load group.

View_StructuralSurfaceAction.description: This entity defines an action which is distributed over a surface.

View_StructuralSurfaceConnection.description: A surface structural-analysis connection or support where members meet over a face.

View_StructuralSurfaceMember.description: A surface structural-analysis idealization of a member such as a slab, wall, or shell.

View_StructuralSurfaceReaction.description: This entity defines a reaction which occurs distributed over a surface.

View_SubContractResource.description: IfcSubContractResource is a construction resource needed in a construction process that represents a sub-contractor.

View_SurfaceFeature.description: A surface feature is a modification at (onto, or into) of the surface of an element.

View_SwitchingDevice.description: A switch is used in a cable distribution system (electrical circuit) to control or modulate the flow of electricity.

View_System.description: A collection of related parts organized to perform a common function or provide a service.

View_SystemFurnitureElement.description: A system furniture element defines components of modular furniture which are not directly placed in a building structure but aggregated inside furniture.

View_Tank.description: A tank is a vessel or container in which a fluid or gas is stored for later use.

View_Task.description: An IfcTask is an identifiable unit of work to be carried out in a construction project.

View_Tendon.description: A tensioned steel wire, cable, bar, rod, or strand used to prestress concrete.

View_TendonAnchor.description: A tendon anchor is the end connection for tendons in prestressed or posttensioned concrete.

View_TendonConduit.description: A TendonConduit represents the components of the conduit system for tendons embedded in concrete structure.

View_TrackElement.description: A track element is a built element used specifically in the track domain in railway.

View_Transformer.description: A transformer is an inductive stationary device that transfers electrical energy from one circuit to another.

View_TransportElement.description: A transport element is a generalization of all transport related objects that move people, animals or goods within a Facility.

View_TubeBundle.description: An assembly of tubes used for heat transfer within equipment such as a chiller or coil.

View_UnitaryControlElement.description: A unitary control element combines a number of control components into a single product, such as a thermostat or humidistat.

View_UnitaryEquipment.description: Unitary equipment typically combine a number of components into a single product, such as air handlers, pre-packaged rooftop air-conditioning units, heat pumps, and split systems.

View_Valve.description: A valve is used in a building services piping distribution system to control or modulate the flow of the fluid.

View_Vehicle.description: Piece of equipment designed to transport people or cargo.

View_VibrationDamper.description: A vibration damper is a device used to minimize the effects of vibration in a structure by dissipating kinetic energy.

View_VibrationIsolator.description: A vibration isolator is a device used to minimize the effects of vibration transmissibility in a structure.

View_VirtualElement.description: A virtual element is a special element used to provide imaginary, placeholder, or provisional areas, volumes, and boundaries.

View_VoidingFeature.description: A voiding feature is a modification of an element which reduces its volume.

View_Wall.description: The wall represents a vertical construction that may bound or subdivide spaces.

View_WasteTerminal.description: A device that collects or intercepts waste from sanitary terminals or other equipment and discharges it into a drainage system.

View_Window.description: The window is a building element that is predominately used to provide natural light and fresh air.

View_WorkCalendar.description: An IfcWorkCalendar defines working and non-working time periods for tasks and resources.

View_WorkPlan.description: An IfcWorkPlan represents work plans in a construction or a facilities management project.

View_WorkSchedule.description: An IfcWorkSchedule represents a task schedule of a work plan, which in turn can contain a set of schedules for different purposes.

View_Zone.description: A zone is a group of spaces, partial spaces or other zones.

IfcColumn.description: A vertical structural or architectural member, often located at an intersection of the structural grid.

IfcCompressor.description: A compressor is a device that compresses a fluid typically used in a refrigeration circuit.

IfcCondenser.description: A heat-rejection device that typically condenses a substance from gas to liquid.

IfcConstructionProductResource.description: IfcConstructionProductResource defines the role of a product that is consumed (wholly or partially), or occupied in the performance of construction.

IfcConstructionResource.description: A general construction resource, including labor, materials, equipment, products, subcontractors, or resource groups such as crews.

IfcContext.description: IfcContext is the generalization of a project context in which objects, type objects, property sets, and properties are defined.

IfcControl.description: IfcControl is the abstract generalization of all concepts that control or constrain the utilization of products, processes, or resources in general.

IfcController.description: A controller is a device that monitors inputs and controls outputs within a building automation system.

IfcCostSchedule.description: A collection of cost items for an estimate, bill of quantities, work order, or another cost-related presentation.

IfcCourse.description: A long, relatively thin layer of material laid on site over another horizontal or nearly horizontal built element.

IfcCovering.description: A finishing or protective covering applied to a surface or element, such as flooring, ceiling, cladding, insulation, or roofing.

IfcCrewResource.description: IfcCrewResource represents a collection of internal resources used in construction processes.

IfcCurtainWall.description: A wall assembly hung from the floor or roof structure rather than supported directly on a floor.

IfcDamper.description: A damper typically participates in an HVAC duct distribution system and is used to control or modulate the flow of air.

IfcDeepFoundation.description: Deep foundation is a type of foundation that transfers loads deeper than shallow foundation below the soft soils not capable of bearing the above structure.

IfcDiscreteAccessory.description: A discrete accessory is a representation of different kinds of accessories included in or added to elements.

IfcDistributionBoard.description: A flow controller that groups electrical or communications devices at one location for a particular purpose.

IfcDistributionChamberElement.description: A distribution chamber element defines a place at which distribution systems and their constituent elements may be inspected or through which they may travel.

IfcDistributionCircuit.description: A distribution circuit is a partition of a distribution system that is conditionally switched such as an electrical circuit.

IfcDistributionControlElement.description: The distribution element IfcDistributionControlElement defines occurrence elements of a building automation control system that are used to impart control over elements of a distribution system.

IfcDistributionElement.description: IfcDistributionElement is a generalization of all elements that participate in a distribution system.

IfcDistributionFlowElement.description: The distribution element IfcDistributionFlowElement defines occurrence elements of a distribution system that facilitate the distribution of energy or matter, such as air, water or power.

IfcDistributionPort.description: A distribution port is an inlet or outlet of a product through which a particular substance may flow.

IfcDistributionSystem.description: A distribution system is a network designed to receive, store, maintain, distribute, or control the flow of a distribution media.

IfcDoor.description: The door is a built element that is predominately used to provide controlled access for people, goods, animals and vehicles.

IfcDuctFitting.description: A junction or transition connecting duct segments and changing flow characteristics such as direction or flow rate.

IfcDuctSegment.description: A duct segment is used to typically join two sections of duct network.

IfcDuctSilencer.description: A device installed in ductwork to reduce noise from airflow or equipment in adjacent spaces or downstream ducts.

IfcEarthworksCut.description: The resulting void from modification of existing terrain or road structure by excavation or by other means of removing material.

IfcEarthworksElement.description: An element created by earthworks to form subgrade, raise ground levels, or reinforce or stabilize soil.

IfcEarthworksFill.description: A type of earthworks element created by earthwork activities to build subgrade or to raise the level of the ground in general.

IfcElectricAppliance.description: An electric appliance is a device intended for consumer usage that is powered by electricity.

IfcElectricDistributionBoard.description: A distribution board is a flow controller in which instances of electrical devices are brought together at a single place for a particular purpose.

IfcElectricFlowStorageDevice.description: An electric flow storage device is a device in which electrical energy is stored and from which energy may be progressively released.

IfcElectricFlowTreatmentDevice.description: An electric flow treatment device is used to remove unwanted matter from an electric or electronic signal in a flow distribution system.

IfcElectricGenerator.description: An electric generator is an engine that is a machine for converting mechanical energy into electrical energy.

IfcElectricMotor.description: An electric motor is an engine that is a machine for converting electrical energy into mechanical energy.

IfcElectricTimeControl.description: An electric time control is a device that applies control to the provision or flow of electrical energy over time.

IfcElement.description: An element is a generalization of all components that make up a facility.

IfcElementAssembly.description: The IfcElementAssembly represents complex element assemblies aggregated from several elements, such as discrete elements, building elements, or other elements.

IfcElementComponent.description: A minor component included in, added to, or connecting larger elements.

IfcEnergyConversionDevice.description: A device within a distribution system that converts energy or transfers heat.

IfcEngine.description: An engine is a device that converts fuel into mechanical energy through combustion.

IfcEvaporativeCooler.description: An evaporative cooler is a device that cools air by saturating it with water vapor.

IfcEvaporator.description: An evaporator is a device in which a liquid refrigerent is vaporized and absorbs heat from the surrounding fluid.

IfcEvent.description: An IfcEvent is something that happens that triggers an action or response.

IfcExternalSpatialElement.description: The external spatial element defines external regions at the building site.

IfcExternalSpatialStructureElement.description: The external spatial structure element is an abstract entity provided for different kind of external spaces, regions, and volumes.

IfcFacility.description: A built facility, such as a building, bridge, railway, road, or marine facility.

IfcFacilityPart.description: IfcFacilityPart provides for spatial breakdown of built facilities.

IfcFacilityPartCommon.description: A part that is not clearly part of one domain but is a hybrid and has shared responsibilities in multiple domains.

IfcFan.description: A fan is a device which imparts mechanical work on a gas.

IfcFastener.description: Representations of fixing parts which are used as fasteners to connect or join elements with other elements.

IfcFeatureElement.description: A feature element is a generalization of all existence dependent elements which modify the shape and appearance of the associated master element.

IfcFeatureElementAddition.description: An existence-dependent feature that adds to or otherwise modifies the shape and appearance of a host element.

IfcFeatureElementSubtraction.description: An existence-dependent feature that subtracts from or otherwise modifies the shape and appearance of a host element.

IfcFilter.description: A filter is an apparatus used to remove particulate or gaseous matter from fluids and gases.

IfcFireSuppressionTerminal.description: A fire suppression terminal has the purpose of delivering a fluid (gas or liquid) that will suppress a fire.

IfcFlowController.description: An element that regulates flow through a distribution system, such as a damper, valve, switch, or relay.

IfcFlowFitting.description: The distribution flow element IfcFlowFitting defines the occurrence of a junction or transition in a flow distribution system, such as an elbow or tee.

IfcFlowInstrument.description: An instrument displaying a system property at a point or the difference in that property between two points.

IfcFlowMeter.description: A flow meter is a device that is used to measure the flow rate in a system.

IfcFlowMovingDevice.description: A device that moves or circulates a liquid or gas through a distribution system, such as a pump or fan.

IfcFlowSegment.description: The distribution flow element IfcFlowSegment defines the occurrence of a segment of a flow distribution system.

IfcFlowStorageDevice.description: A device used for temporary storage within a distribution system, such as a tank.

IfcFlowTerminal.description: A permanently attached endpoint or starting point of a distribution system, such as an air outlet, drain, or sink.

IfcFlowTreatmentDevice.description: A distribution-system device that removes unwanted material from a liquid or gas.

IfcFooting.description: A footing is a part of the foundation of a structure that spreads and transmits the load to the soil.

IfcFurnishingElement.description: A furnishing element is a generalization of all furniture related objects.

IfcFurniture.description: Furniture defines complete furnishings such as a table, desk, chair, or cabinet, which may or may not be permanently attached to a building structure.

IfcGeographicElement.description: An IfcGeographicElement is a generalization of all elements within a geographical landscape.

IfcGeomodel.description: Representation of the concept of a volumetric geological and geotechnical model, usually an interpretation but sometimes created direct from ground penetrating measurement.

IfcGeoslice.description: Representation of the concept of a sectional planar geological and geotechnical model, usually an interpretation but sometimes created direct from ground penetrating measurement.

IfcGeotechnicalAssembly.description: Representation of the abstract concept of a geological and geotechnical model, usually an interpretation but sometimes created direct from ground penetrating measurement.

IfcGeotechnicalStratum.description: A discrete, approximately homogeneous geological feature represented as a solid, a top surface, or voxels.

IfcGrid.description: A planar design grid positioned in three-dimensional space to locate structural and other design elements.

IfcGroup.description: An arbitrary grouping of objects for a shared purpose or organizational context.

IfcHeatExchanger.description: A heat exchanger is a device used to provide heat transfer between non-mixing media such as plate and shell and tube heat exchangers.

IfcHumidifier.description: A humidifier is a device that adds moisture into the air.

IfcImpactProtectionDevice.description: An impact protection device is a component used to protect other built elements from kinetic damage.

IfcInterceptor.description: A gravity drainage device that retains unwanted or hazardous matter while allowing sewage or other liquids to discharge.

IfcInventory.description: An inventory is a list of items within an enterprise.

IfcJunctionBox.description: A junction box is an enclosure within which cables are connected.

IfcKerb.description: A border of stone, concrete or other rigid material formed at the edge of the carriageway or footway.

IfcLaborResource.description: An IfcLaborResource is used in construction with particular skills or crafts required to perform certain types of construction or management related work.

IfcLamp.description: A lamp is an artificial light source such as a light bulb or tube.

IfcLightFixture.description: A housing for one or more lamps, optionally including devices that control or modify their light output.

IfcLinearElement.description: A generalization of all linear elements that are parts of an alignment.

IfcLinearPositioningElement.description: An IfcLinearPositioningElement is an entity describing positioning according to a curve.

IfcLiquidTerminal.description: An endpoint or starting point where a liquid distribution system exchanges liquid with its external environment.

IfcMarineFacility.description: A major facility in the ports and waterways domain, such as a quay, jetty, shipyard, or breakwater.

IfcMechanicalFastener.description: A component that mechanically joins building elements or their parts.

IfcMedicalDevice.description: A medical device is attached to a medical piping system and operates upon medical gases to perform a specific function.

IfcMember.description: An IfcMember is a structural member designed to carry loads between or beyond points of support.

IfcMobileTelecommunicationsAppliance.description: A mobile telecommunications appliance is a device that transmits, converts, amplifies or receives signals used in mobile networks.

IfcMooringDevice.description: An active or passive component used to secure a vessel, such as a bollard or quick-release hook.

IfcMotorConnection.description: A motor connection provides the means for connecting a motor as the driving device to the driven device.

IfcNavigationElement.description: An active or passive component providing navigational instructions or warnings to vessels, such as a buoy or beacon.

IfcObject.description: An IfcObject is the generalization of any semantically treated thing or process.

IfcObjectDefinition.description: A general semantic definition of an object or process, including object occurrences and object types.

IfcOccupant.description: An actor identifying the form of occupancy of a property.

IfcOpeningElement.description: The opening element stands for opening, recess or chase, all reflecting voids.

IfcOutlet.description: An outlet is a device installed at a point to receive one or more inserted plugs for electrical power or communications.

IfcPavement.description: A road or paved-area element providing an even load-carrying surface for vehicles or pedestrians, usually composed of several courses.

IfcPerformanceHistory.description: IfcPerformanceHistory is used to document the actual performance of an occurrence instance over time.

IfcPermit.description: A permit is a permission to perform work in places and on artifacts where regulatory, security or other access restrictions apply.

IfcPile.description: A slender foundation member embedded into the ground to support a load.

IfcPipeFitting.description: A junction or transition connecting pipe segments and changing flow characteristics such as direction or flow rate.

IfcPipeSegment.description: A pipe segment is used to typically join two sections of a piping network.

IfcPlate.description: An IfcPlate is a planar and often flat part with constant thickness.

IfcPort.description: A port provides the means for an element to connect to other elements.

IfcPositioningElement.description: New and abstract entity definition for positioning and annotating elements that are used to position other elements relatively.

IfcProcedure.description: An IfcProcedure is a logical set of actions to be taken in response to an event or to cause an event to occur.

IfcProcess.description: An activity or event occurring in time, with possible sequence and input/output relationships to other processes.

IfcProduct.description: The IfcProduct is an abstract representation of any object that relates to a geometric or spatial context.

IfcProject.description: IfcProject establishes the context for information to be exchanged or shared, and it may represent a construction project but does not have to.

IfcProjectLibrary.description: An IfcProjectLibrary collects all library elements that are included within a referenced project data set.

IfcProjectOrder.description: A project order is a directive to purchase products and/or perform work, such as for construction or facilities management.

IfcProjectionElement.description: The projection element is a specialization of the general feature element to represent projections applied to building elements.

IfcProtectiveDevice.description: A protective device breaks an electrical circuit when a stated electric current that passes through it is exceeded.

IfcProtectiveDeviceTrippingUnit.description: A device that triggers a separate circuit-breaking unit when current exceeds a specified level.

IfcPump.description: A pump is a device which imparts mechanical work on fluids or slurries to move them through a channel or pipeline.

IfcRail.description: A rail is a predominately linear built element that has a special section profile.

IfcRailing.description: A frame assembly beside pedestrian or vehicle circulation spaces or boundaries, used in place of or together with walls.

IfcRailway.description: An IfcRailway is a spatial structure element as a route from one location to another for guided passage of wheeled vehicles on rails.

IfcRamp.description: An inclined passage linking levels at different elevations.

IfcRampFlight.description: A single inclined ramp segment connecting landings, floors, or slabs at different elevations.

IfcReferent.description: IfcReferent defines a position at a particular offset along an alignment curve.

IfcReinforcedSoil.description: Soil reinforced or stabilized by some mechanical or chemical method.

IfcReinforcingBar.description: A reinforcing bar is usually made of steel with manufactured deformations in the surface, and used in concrete and masonry construction to provide additional strength.

IfcReinforcingElement.description: A component embedded in concrete so that it acts together with the concrete to resist forces.

IfcReinforcingMesh.description: A welded grid of longitudinal and transverse wires or bars, commonly used to reinforce concrete slabs.

IfcResource.description: IfcResource contains the information needed to represent the costs, schedule, and other impacts from the use of a thing in a process.

IfcRoad.description: A route built on land to allow travel from one location to another, including highways, streets, cycle and foot paths, but excluding railways.

IfcRoof.description: The top covering of a building, protecting it from weather.

IfcSanitaryTerminal.description: A fixed water-related appliance or terminal for drinking, cleaning, or foul-water disposal, including equipment directly serving it.

IfcSensor.description: A device that measures a physical quantity and converts the measurement into a readable signal.

IfcShadingDevice.description: A purpose-built device that limits sunlight, natural light, or visibility.

IfcSign.description: A sign is a notice on display that gives information or instructions in a written, symbolic or other form.

IfcSignal.description: A signal is an active device that conveys information or instructions to users, by means of an audio, visual signal or a combination of both.

IfcSite.description: A site is a defined area of land, possibly covered with water, on which the project construction is to be completed.

IfcSlab.description: A slab is a component of the construction that may enclose a space vertically.

IfcSolarDevice.description: A solar device converts solar radiation into other energy such as electric current or thermal energy.

IfcSpace.description: A space represents an area or volume bounded actually or theoretically.

IfcSpaceHeater.description: A device that heats a limited space through radiation or natural convection using electricity, steam, or hot water.

IfcSpatialElement.description: A spatial element is the generalization of all spatial elements that might be used to define a spatial structure or to define spatial zones.

IfcSpatialStructureElement.description: A spatial structure element is the generalization of all spatial elements that might be used to define a spatial structure.

IfcSpatialZone.description: A spatial zone is a non-hierarchical and potentially overlapping decomposition of the project under some functional consideration.

IfcStackTerminal.description: A terminal at the top of a ventilating stack or rainwater pipe, providing protection or collecting discharge from guttering.

IfcStair.description: A stair is a vertical passageway allowing occupants to walk (step) from one floor level to another floor level at a different elevation.

IfcStairFlight.description: A stair flight is an assembly of building components in a single "run" of stair steps (not interrupted by a landing).

IfcStructuralAction.description: A structural action is a structural activity that acts upon a structural item or building element.

IfcStructuralActivity.description: A structural action or reaction, such as a load, displacement, support reaction, internal force, or deflection.

IfcStructuralAnalysisModel.description: The IfcStructuralAnalysisModel is used to assemble all information needed to represent a structural analysis model.

IfcStructuralConnection.description: An IfcStructuralConnection represents a structural connection object (node connection, edge connection, or surface connection) or supports.

IfcStructuralCurveAction.description: A structural curve action defines an action which is distributed over a curve.

IfcStructuralCurveConnection.description: A linear structural-analysis connection or support where surface members meet along an edge.

IfcStructuralCurveMember.description: A linear structural-analysis idealization of a member such as a beam, column, or rod.

IfcStructuralCurveMemberVarying.description: This entity describes edge members with varying profile properties.

IfcStructuralCurveReaction.description: This entity defines a reaction which occurs distributed over a curve.

IfcStructuralItem.description: The abstract entity IfcStructuralItem is the generalization of structural members and structural connections, that is, analysis idealizations of elements in the building model.

IfcStructuralLinearAction.description: This entity defines an action with constant value which is distributed over a curve.

IfcStructuralLoadCase.description: A load case is a load group, commonly used to group loads from the same action source.

IfcStructuralLoadGroup.description: The entity IfcStructuralLoadGroup is used to structure the physical impacts.

IfcStructuralMember.description: The abstract entity IfcStructuralMember is the superclass of all structural items which represent the idealized structural behavior of building elements.

IfcStructuralPlanarAction.description: This entity defines an action with constant value which is distributed over a surface.

IfcStructuralPointAction.description: This entity defines an action which acts on a point.

IfcStructuralPointConnection.description: Instances of IfcStructuralPointConnection describe structural nodes or point supports.

IfcStructuralPointReaction.description: This entity defines a reaction which occurs at a point.

IfcStructuralReaction.description: A structural reaction is a structural activity that results from a structural action imposed to a structural item or building element.

IfcStructuralResultGroup.description: Instances of the entity IfcStructuralResultGroup are used to group results of structural analysis calculations and to capture the connection to the underlying basic load group.

IfcStructuralSurfaceAction.description: This entity defines an action which is distributed over a surface.

IfcStructuralSurfaceConnection.description: A surface structural-analysis connection or support where members meet over a face.

IfcStructuralSurfaceMember.description: A surface structural-analysis idealization of a member such as a slab, wall, or shell.

IfcStructuralSurfaceMemberVarying.description: This entity describes surface members with varying section properties.

IfcStructuralSurfaceReaction.description: This entity defines a reaction which occurs distributed over a surface.

IfcSubContractResource.description: IfcSubContractResource is a construction resource needed in a construction process that represents a sub-contractor.

IfcSurfaceFeature.description: A surface feature is a modification at (onto, or into) of the surface of an element.

IfcSwitchingDevice.description: A switch is used in a cable distribution system (electrical circuit) to control or modulate the flow of electricity.

IfcSystem.description: A collection of related parts organized to perform a common function or provide a service.

IfcSystemFurnitureElement.description: A system furniture element defines components of modular furniture which are not directly placed in a building structure but aggregated inside furniture.

IfcTank.description: A tank is a vessel or container in which a fluid or gas is stored for later use.

IfcTask.description: An IfcTask is an identifiable unit of work to be carried out in a construction project.

IfcTendon.description: A tensioned steel wire, cable, bar, rod, or strand used to prestress concrete.

IfcTendonAnchor.description: A tendon anchor is the end connection for tendons in prestressed or posttensioned concrete.

IfcTendonConduit.description: A TendonConduit represents the components of the conduit system for tendons embedded in concrete structure.

IfcTrackElement.description: A track element is a built element used specifically in the track domain in railway.

IfcTransformer.description: A transformer is an inductive stationary device that transfers electrical energy from one circuit to another.

IfcTransportElement.description: A transport element is a generalization of all transport related objects that move people, animals or goods within a Facility.

IfcTransportationDevice.description: Abstract intermediate supertype for transportation devices.

IfcTubeBundle.description: An assembly of tubes used for heat transfer within equipment such as a chiller or coil.

IfcUnitaryControlElement.description: A unitary control element combines a number of control components into a single product, such as a thermostat or humidistat.

IfcUnitaryEquipment.description: Unitary equipment typically combine a number of components into a single product, such as air handlers, pre-packaged rooftop air-conditioning units, heat pumps, and split systems.

IfcValve.description: A valve is used in a building services piping distribution system to control or modulate the flow of the fluid.

IfcVehicle.description: Piece of equipment designed to transport people or cargo.

IfcVibrationDamper.description: A vibration damper is a device used to minimize the effects of vibration in a structure by dissipating kinetic energy.

IfcVibrationIsolator.description: A vibration isolator is a device used to minimize the effects of vibration transmissibility in a structure.

IfcVirtualElement.description: A virtual element is a special element used to provide imaginary, placeholder, or provisional areas, volumes, and boundaries.

IfcVoidingFeature.description: A voiding feature is a modification of an element which reduces its volume.

IfcWall.description: The wall represents a vertical construction that may bound or subdivide spaces.

IfcWallStandardCase.description: The IfcWallStandardCase defines a wall with certain constraints for the provision of parameters and with certain constraints for the geometric representation.

IfcWasteTerminal.description: A device that collects or intercepts waste from sanitary terminals or other equipment and discharges it into a drainage system.

IfcWindow.description: The window is a building element that is predominately used to provide natural light and fresh air.

IfcWorkCalendar.description: An IfcWorkCalendar defines working and non-working time periods for tasks and resources.

IfcWorkControl.description: An IfcWorkControl is an abstract supertype which captures information that is common to both IfcWorkPlan and IfcWorkSchedule.

IfcWorkPlan.description: An IfcWorkPlan represents work plans in a construction or a facilities management project.

IfcWorkSchedule.description: An IfcWorkSchedule represents a task schedule of a work plan, which in turn can contain a set of schedules for different purposes.

IfcZone.description: A zone is a group of spaces, partial spaces or other zones.
